name: Zephyr Beverages
riskAppetite: Pragmatic and launch-oriented: ships fast-moving beverage SKUs, supplement lines, and apparel collaborations, and wants clear go / no-go calls with a practical path around real blockers rather than exhaustive caveats. Surface the conflicts that could realistically stop or reshape a launch and the cleanest workaround for each; keep minor register noise brief. Willing to defend its core marks, so genuine adverse rights are worth flagging even when the commercial impact looks modest.

jxPolicy.escalationPolicy: Escalate a native-script hit to full record review when the owner also holds a Latin-script registration in the same class — a squatter and an incumbent read very differently on the same evidence.
